title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Roasted sweet potato, smoky beans, and a lime crema that does the heavy lifting.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Toss the sweet potato with the olive oil, paprika, cumin and a good pinch of salt.
Roast on the top shelf, turning once, until the edges have caught and the middles are soft.

steps: Add the beans to the tray for the last five minutes, just long enough to dry out and split their skins.
Stir the lime zest and half the juice into the sour cream, and season it.

steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they puff and blister in patches.

steps: Build each taco with crema first so it sticks, then the sweet potato and beans, cabbage, avocado, and the rest of the lime juice.
